title: GEO / AEO visibility outputs
description: Only successful visibility snapshots enter the billable default dataset. The run summary and source errors are separate key-value-store outputs, without per-result charges.

defaultDataset.title: Successful visibility checks
defaultDataset.description: One billable snapshot per successful query, market and source-Actor check. No summary or error rows. Valid search evidence can be returned even when an AI answer is unavailable.

report.title: Run report and historical changes
report.description: Aggregate report_summary, historical comparisons, source budget and parent event-charge accounting. No per-result charge for this report; ordinary storage costs can apply.

errors.title: Source errors (no per-result charge)
errors.description: Source diagnostics, including failures that do not produce billable snapshots. Source Actor and platform costs can still apply.
